recipes.name: Chicken Keema Paratha
instructions: Knead whole wheat flour with water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough, then cover and rest.
Heat half the oil in a pan, add chopped onion, green chilli, and ginger, cooking until onions soften.
Add minced chicken breast, salt, red chilli powder, and garam masala to the pan.
Cook the chicken mix thoroughly for 8-10 minutes until completely dry, then mix in fresh coriander leaves and let cool.
Divide the rested dough into two equal portions and roll each into a small disc.
Place half of the cooled chicken stuffing in the center of a dough disc, pleat the edges to seal, and flatten.
Roll out the stuffed dough gently into a thick paratha using dry flour to avoid tearing.
Cook on a hot tawa on both sides, applying the remaining oil until golden brown spots appear.
Repeat the rolling and cooking process for the second portion and serve hot.

recipes.name: Chicken Poha
instructions: Rinse poha in a colander under running water for a few seconds, drain completely, and set aside to soften.
Heat groundnut oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, and let them splutter.
Add the chopped onion, green chilli, and curry leaves to the pan, sautéing until onions turn translucent.
Add the finely minced chicken breast, turmeric powder, and half the salt.
Sauté the chicken on medium heat for 6-8 minutes until it is completely cooked and slightly browned.
Fluff the softened poha gently with a fork and add it to the pan along with the remaining salt.
Mix everything thoroughly but gently to avoid breaking the flattened rice grains.
Cover the pan with a lid and steam on low heat for 2-3 minutes.
Turn off the heat, stir in lemon juice and fresh coriander leaves, then serve hot.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry with Rice
instructions: Wash and soak the basmati rice in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Boil the soaked rice in water with a pinch of salt until fully cooked, drain excess water, and set aside.
Heat sunflower oil in a separate pan, add chopped onions, and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger paste and garlic paste, frying for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato puree, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and salt, cooking until the oil begins to separate.
Add the diced chicken thigh pieces and stir well to coat them thoroughly with the masala base.
Pour in one cup of water, cover the pan, and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and simmer for another 2 minutes, then garnish with fresh coriander leaves.
Serve the chicken curry hot alongside the cooked basmati rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Marinate the chicken pieces with curd, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, and half the salt for 30 minutes.
Wash the basmati rice and soak it in water for 20 minutes, then drain completely.
Parboil the soaked rice in plenty of salted water with cloves and cinnamon until it is 70% cooked, then drain.
Heat ghee in a large heavy-bottomed pot, add the sliced onions, and fry until golden brown.
Add the ginger and garlic pastes along with slit green chillies, sautéing for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften completely.
Add the marinated chicken pieces to the pot and cook on high heat for 5 minutes until sealed.
Reduce heat, cover, and let the chicken cook in its own juices for 10 minutes.
Layer the parboiled rice evenly over the chicken base, scatter fresh coriander leaves on top, cover tightly, and cook on very low heat (Dum) for 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken Lite
instructions: Marinate chicken breast cubes with curd, ginger paste, garlic paste, and half the salt for 20 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, add the marinated chicken, and cook until golden and tender, then remove.
In the same pan, melt the butter, then add the pureed tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir the ground cashew paste into the tomatoes and simmer until the mixture thickens slightly.
Add the remaining salt, garam masala, and a splash of water to form a smooth gravy.
Return the cooked chicken pieces to the gravy and simmer together for 5 minutes.
Stir in the fresh cream and crushed kasuri methi, blending well on low heat.
Remove from heat and serve hot.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Salad
instructions: Marinate the chicken strips in curd, red chilli powder, garam masala, and half the salt for 15 minutes.
Heat the sunflower oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add the marinated chicken strips and pan-sear them for 6-8 minutes until cooked through and lightly charred.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced onions, capsicum, and deseeded tomatoes.
Transfer the hot chicken tikka pieces into the bowl with the fresh vegetables.
Toss the mixture together with the remaining salt and lemon juice.
Serve immediately as a light, high-protein meal.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the Sona Masoori rice in advance, drain thoroughly, fluff, and ensure it is completely cold before using.
Heat half the sunflower oil in a wok or deep pan over high heat, add the chicken pieces, and stir-fry until cooked and white throughout, then remove.
Add the remaining oil to the same wok on high heat and toss in the chopped garlic and onions, stir-frying for 1 minute.
Add the finely chopped carrots and french beans, stir-frying rapidly for 2-3 minutes so they stay crisp.
Return the cooked chicken back to the wok alongside the vegetables.
Add the cold cooked rice, spreading it evenly across the wok.
Season everything with salt and freshly crushed black pepper.
Toss the fried rice continuously on high heat for 2 minutes until everything is evenly incorporated and heated through.

recipes.name: Chicken Chettinad
instructions: Dry roast coriander seeds, cumin, fennel seeds, and dried red chillies in a pan until fragrant, then grind with a little water into a smooth masala paste.
Heat sesame oil in a pot, add the fresh curry leaves, and let them crackle.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until dark golden brown.
Stir in the ginger paste and garlic paste, frying for 1 minute to remove the raw smell.
Add the chopped tomatoes and turmeric powder, cooking until the tomatoes mash completely.
Add the prepared Chettinad masala paste and salt, stir-frying for 2 minutes over medium heat.
Add the chicken thigh pieces and toss thoroughly to coat them in the rich spice mixture.
Pour in half a cup of water, cover the pot, and cook on medium-low heat for 18-20 minutes until the chicken is tender and the gravy is thick.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken and Veggie Bowl
instructions: Marinate the chicken breast fillets with minced garlic, lemon juice, half the crushed black pepper, and half the salt for 15 minutes.
Steam the sliced carrots and cauliflower florets for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp, then set aside.
Heat half the sunflower oil in a grill pan or non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Place the marinated chicken breast fillets in the pan and grill for 5-6 minutes on each side until fully cooked.
Remove the cooked chicken from the pan, let it rest briefly, and slice into strips.
Add the remaining oil to the same pan and toss in the diced capsicum along with the steamed carrots and cauliflower.
Sauté the vegetables on high heat for 2 minutes, seasoning with the remaining salt and black pepper.
Assemble the meal bowls by placing the sautéed vegetables on one side and the grilled chicken strips on the other.

recipes.name: Chicken Saagwala
instructions: Blanch the fresh spinach leaves in boiling water for 2 minutes, plunge them into cold water, and puree smoothly.
Heat sunflower oil in a pan, add the cumin seeds, and let them sizzle.
Add the finely chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Incorporate the ginger paste and garlic paste, frying for an additional minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften completely.
Add the chicken thigh cubes and sauté for 5 minutes until the meat turns opaque.
Pour in the spinach puree and add the salt, mixing thoroughly.
Cover the pan and simmer on low heat for 10-12 minutes until the chicken is thoroughly cooked.
Stir in the garam masala just before turning off the heat, mixing gently.

recipes.name: Chicken Shorba
instructions: Heat sunflower oil in a deep pot, add the chopped onions, and sauté until they turn light brown.
Add the ginger paste and garlic paste, sautéing briefly for 30 seconds.
Add the small chicken breast cubes along with turmeric powder, cumin powder, and half the black pepper.
Sauté the chicken pieces for 3-4 minutes until they turn white exteriorly.
Pour in 2.5 cups of water and add the salt, stirring well to combine.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover with a lid, and simmer for 12-15 minutes.
Stir in the remaining black pepper powder and check the seasoning.
Garnish with fresh chopped coriander leaves and serve warm as a soothing broth.

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Make shallow cuts across the chicken thigh chunks to help the marinade penetrate.
In a bowl, mix thick curd, mustard oil, ginger paste, garlic paste, red chilli powder, garam masala, crushed kasuri methi, salt, and lemon juice into a smooth paste.
Rub the marinade thoroughly into the chicken pieces and set aside to rest for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat your oven to 220°C (or heat a non-stick grill pan over high heat).
Place the marinated chicken chunks on a wire rack or directly onto the hot pan.
Roast or pan-grill for 10-12 minutes on one side until slightly charred.
Flip the chicken pieces over and cook the other side for another 10 minutes until completely cooked and edges are smoky.
Remove from heat, let it rest for 2 minutes, and serve hot.
